triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Towering like a mountain above all the rest stood the fatal, insoluble question: How would things end between his father and his brother Dmitri with this terrible woman?

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ivan had made a step towards him, which was what Alyosha had been long desiring.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Alyosha realized at the first glance, at the first word, that all the tragedy of her position in relation to the man she loved so dearly was no secret to her

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: He expressed this thought almost plainly to Dmitri when, after the visit, his brother besought and insisted that he should not conceal his impressions on seeing his betrothed.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: I’ve been tormented all the week, trying to think how to prevent him from being ashamed to face me because he spent that three thousand.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: It was by now seven o’clock, and it was getting dark as Alyosha entered the very spacious and convenient house in the High Street occupied by Katerina Ivanovna.

triples.subject: Agafya Ivanovna
triples.quote: One of them, a woman of little education, was that aunt of her half-sister Agafya Ivanovna who had looked after her in her father’s house when she came from boarding-school.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: “Insolent creature!” cried Katerina Ivanovna, as though suddenly grasping something. She flushed all over and leapt up from her seat.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: “So I shall tell Mitya how you kissed my hand, but I didn’t kiss yours at all. And how he will laugh!”

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna at once made her sit down in an arm-chair facing Alyosha, and ecstatically kissed her several times on her smiling lips. She seemed quite in love with her.

triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: I may take to Mitya again. I liked him very much once—liked him for almost a whole hour. Now maybe I shall go and tell him to stay with me from this day forward.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: “Insolent creature!” cried Katerina Ivanovna, as though suddenly grasping something.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Your brother’s a scoundrel, Alexey Fyodorovitch.

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Alyosha took the little pink envelope mechanically and put it, almost unconsciously, into his pocket.
